name: FivesFlow
summary:
FivesFlow is a musical number-merging puzzle for Meta Quest 3 and Quest 3S. Match 5, 10, 20 and beyond, plan your next move and hear larger merges climb the notes.

FIVE MODES IN A 2D GAME PANEL
• Free Fall: steer falling 5, 10 and 20 tiles, drop quickly and build matching cascades on a 6×10 board. Connected pairs can appear as the pace rises. Any settled column reaching the top ends the run. Available immediately, with no Undo.
• Career: 50 stages, rising targets and earned board expansions.
